skill_name: Compare and contrast the skills needed for a lawyer and an accountant.
workflow: Lawyers and accountants both require strong analytical and problem solving skills, but there are some differences. Lawyers typically need to be detail-oriented and have an extensive knowledge of the law, research capabilities, and a good understanding of legal jargon. Accountants, on the other hand, should have an in-depth knowledge of financial laws, accounting principles, and tax regulations, as well as excellent mathematical and organizational skills.
